ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.

19. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

21. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Safe Travel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Environmental and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating messages and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment collecting rain water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
